'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Airstrike campaign in Yemen]]
***[[March 2025 United States attacks in Yemen]]
****[[United States government group chat leak|United States government Signal group chat leak]]
*****A [[Signal (software)|Signal]] group chat containing many of [[Second cabinet of Donald Trump|President Trump's cabinet]], discussing several topics including potential strikes in Yemen, is discovered after journalist [[Jeffrey Goldberg]] is accidentally added to it. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/03/24/politics/yemen-strikes-journalist-cabinet-signal-chat/index.html?iid=cnn_buildContentRecirc_end_recirc (CNN)]
****The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] launches air raids across [[Houthis|Houthi]]-controlled areas of [[Yemen]] overnight, killing at least four people and injuring 13 others in the capital city [[Sanaa]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/us-air-strikes-yemen-kill-four-wound-two (Middle East Eye)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Russian occupation of Sumy Oblast|Russian re-occupation of Sumy Oblast]]
***Ninety people are injured, including 17 children, in a [[Russia]]n [[missile]] attack on a hospital, a school, and a residential area in [[Sumy]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/03/24/us-russia-talks-on-ukraine-ceasefire-end-after-12-hours_6739481_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
**[[Luhansk Oblast campaign]]
***A [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[artillery]] strike kills six people, including several journalists from Russia's [[Izvestia|''Izvestia'' newspaper]] and [[Zvezda (TV channel)|Zvezda]] [[state media]] network in [[Luhansk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-artillery-attack-kills-six-east-including-three-journalists-regional-2025-03-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[United States]] and Russia conclude talks focusing on a [[ceasefire]] for the [[Black Sea]] between [[Kyiv]] and [[Moscow]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-delegation-aims-black-sea-ceasefire-ukraine-russia-talks-2025-03-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–present United Kingdom cost-of-living crisis|United Kingdom cost-of-living crisis]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[supermarket]] [[chain store|chain]] [[Morrisons]] announces that it will permanently close 52 cafés and 17 stores as part of cost-cutting measures, with the [[layoff|loss]] of at least 365 jobs expected. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqx0v5xprz4o (BBC News)]
*[[United States|American]] [[genetic testing]] company [[23andMe]] files for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 11 bankruptcy]] and announces plans to sell its assets. [https://apnews.com/article/23andme-chapter-11-bankruptcy-wojcicki-resigns-9827549d9171a537e76f60cb950d1823 (AP)]

*Twenty-two people are killed in a road accident in [[Gondola District]], [[Manica]], [[Mozambique]]. [https://english.news.cn/20250325/88cff72ae234416dbd0ff63f17f9efe3/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Proposed United States acquisition of Greenland]]
**[[Naalakkersuisut|Greenlandic]] [[Prime Minister of Greenland|prime minister]] [[Múte Bourup Egede]] says a planned visit to the island by senior [[United States|American]] officials, including [[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Advisor]] [[Mike Waltz]] and [[Second Lady of the United States|Second Lady]] [[Usha Vance]], is "highly aggressive" and was designed to "demonstrate power over us". [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/03/24/world/greenland-prime-minister-us-usha-vance-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Turkish protests]]
**Over 1,100 [[Turkey|Turkish]] anti-government protesters have been detained since the [[Arrest of Ekrem İmamoğlu|arrest of Ekrem İmamoğlu]], with [[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan|Tayyip Erdoğan]] accusing the demonstrations of being a "movement of violence". *[[Impeachment of Han Duck-soo]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of South Korea]] dismisses the [[impeachment]] motion of [[Prime Minister of South Korea|prime minister]] [[Han Duck-soo]] by the [[National Assembly of South Korea]] in a 7–1 vote. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250324002752315 (Yonhap)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-koreas-constitutional-court-strikes-down-impeachment-pm-han-duck-soo-2025-03-24/ (Reuters)]
*One man is killed and another person wounded in a combined [[vehicle-ramming attack|ramming]], [[stabbing attack|stabbing]], and shooting attack by an Israeli Arab assailant at a bus stop in [[Yokneam Illit]], [[Israel]].
